subject: Contract hop: short redline sync + demo touchpoint
body:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Megan Lu <megan.lu@harborline.com>, procurement@harborline.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract hop: short redline sync + demo touchpoint

Hi Megan / Harborline procurement team,

Thanks again for the quick review yesterday. To keep momentum on the MSA redlines and lock the demo onboarding window, can we do a short "contract hop" — 20–30 minutes — to run the last open items and confirm procurement timing? Goal is to: 1) confirm the two remaining redlines (sec/data retention + liability cap), 2) decide billing cadence for the pilot, and 3) set a concrete demo/onboarding date for the week of May 10.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed 4/28 11:00–11:30am PDT (14:00–14:30 EDT)
- Wed 4/28 2:00–2:30pm PDT (17:00–17:30 EDT)
- Thu 4/29 9:00–9:30am PDT (12:00–12:30 EDT)

I attached the latest redline (Harborline_MSA_redline_v2.docx) and a 1-page agenda (contract-hop-agenda.pdf). If legal must be on the call, please let us know and we will pull Laura in — otherwise we can do a procurement + AE sync and escalate only the specific clauses.

Quick ask: do you need an estimated invoice schedule to accompany the MSA for your procurement queue? If yes, we can include a sample invoice cadence in the 10-minute pre-read.

Thanks,
Karthik

---
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192


On Tue, Apr 27, 2027 at 12:28 PM EDT, Megan Lu <megan.lu@harborline.com> wrote:
> Hi Karthik —
>
> Thanks for sending these over and for the clear agenda. We can do a 20-minute hop; procurement would prefer something short and action-oriented. A couple of quick notes from our side before we book: 
>
> - Can you attach the latest MSA redline (we only have v1 in our tracker)?
> - Our legal counsel (cc'd: procurement@harborline.com) only needs to join if you expect new language on data retention or PI processing — otherwise procurement + our PM should be enough.
> - We have an internal cutoff for May invoicing that requires signed terms by 5/6 to hit the May cycle. If that's tight on your side, flag it and we'll see if June cycle is necessary.
>
> Our availability (EDT):
> - Wed 4/28 14:00–14:20 EDT
> - Wed 4/28 17:00–17:20 EDT (less ideal)
> - Thu 4/29 12:00–12:20 EDT
>
> If you can do the 14:00 EDT slot we'll take it and loop legal only if clause edits are proposed.
>
> Best,
> Megan
>
> Megan Lu
> Senior Procurement Manager | Harborline Therapeutics
> megan.lu@harborline.com | +1 (202) 555-0118


From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Megan Lu <megan.lu@harborline.com>, procurement@harborline.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract hop: short redline sync + demo touchpoint

Thanks Megan — 14:00 EDT works for us. Two quick items: 

1) Laura (legal) is briefly tied up at that time with a board prep review; she asked that we try to keep this to 20 minutes and only bring legal in if we push a new version with substantive edits. I will have Marissa (CS) on the call to confirm onboarding dates.

2) I attached Harborline_MSA_redline_v2.docx here again (see attached). The redline includes one tracked change in Section 7 (liability cap) and a proposed note in the data retention appendix (Section D) that limits logs retention to 90 days for pilot workloads — legal flagged this as the only potential escalation.

Given the 5/6 procurement invoice cutoff you mentioned, if we can get signed terms that week we will push the purchase order through and target a May billing date. If not, we will agree to a June start and hold the demo cadence until signature.

Confirming: Wed 4/28 14:00–14:20 EDT (11:00–11:20 PDT). I'll send a calendar invite and include the 1-page agenda.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Harborline_MSA_redline_v2.docx (document, 198KB); contract-hop-agenda.pdf (pdf, 1 page)


From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Megan Lu <megan.lu@harborline.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Contract hop: short redline sync + demo touchpoint

Hi all —

Quick confirmation from legal: I reviewed the redline and the only clause that will likely require a 2–3 minute escalation is the liability cap language in Section 7. If Harborline is amenable to Redwood's proposed pro-rata clause tied to pilot usage (the tracked change on page 7), we can close without a separate legal call.

I've accepted the 14:00 EDT calendar invite and added a 10-minute buffer to my schedule in case we need to run through Section D (data retention). I also uploaded the redline to the shared drive and added comments to Section D with recommended language (link below).

See you on the hop.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0250

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid-harborline-msa
